q1_issues.issue: (Patient sk_capture_1 al_qaida) treats capturing as changing its object, but by the instruction set's own "abducting a diplomat" ruling, seizing an otherwise unchanged entity takes Theme.
claim takes (Agent sk_claim_1 sk_iranian_1) while say takes Experiencer in the same parse, though the instruction set lists both among the attitude verbs whose holder is an Experiencer.

q2_gaps: Direct quotation as the complement of a speech verb — the instruction set covers only finite "that"-clauses, and says nothing about whether verbatim quoted speech seals as a proposition or is recorded as an utterance.

A compound kind whose modifier is a proper noun ("the White House press secretary") — the compound rules fuse it to white_house_press_secretary, swallowing the name White House so it gets no symbol and no Name atom, while the naming rules treat a capitalized run as one opaque name.
notes: Sealing of the report, projection of the definite groups and the al-Qaida Name, the appositive taking the host clause's Past wrapper, and the perfect-infinitive Before inside the seal are all per the instruction set. (Member sk_step_1 insufficient) on the group symbol is defensible as a genuinely collective property.
